units.source: Wahapedia, aptitude « Warp Lightning Blast » (Passive) : « Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends. »
units.note: Dégâts de l'arme portés par son aptitude (Wahapedia : dégâts « - » = 0) : traduits pour le moteur, 1 BM par touche sans jet pour blesser ni sauvegarde (combat._is_mortal_on_hit). Équivalent au crit mortel sur la valeur de toucher proposé par l'utilisateur, mais un +1 touche compte.

units.source: Wahapedia, aptitude « Cometstrike Sceptre » (Passive) : « Each time this unit attacks with its Cometstrike Sceptre, if the attack scores a hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. »
units.note: Dégâts de l'arme portés par son aptitude (Wahapedia : dégâts « - » = 0) : D3 BM par touche, moyenne 2 (dégâts entiers dans le moteur), sans jet pour blesser ni sauvegarde. Signalé par l'utilisateur après le Warp Lightning Cannon.

abilities.name: DEPICT RUNE
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your battle scripture. The effect and conditional enhanced effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your battle scripture for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.
Varinor, Rune of Strength: Pick up to 2 friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
- While Ydriliqi, Rune of the River is depicted on your battle scripture, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's melee attacks.
- While Oreali, Rune of the Wind is depicted on your battle scripture, each target can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain: Pick up to 2 friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Each target has WARD (5+). In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
- While Varinor, Rune of Strength is depicted on your battle scripture, the targets' melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).
- While Ydriliqi, Rune of the River is depicted on your battle scripture, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with one or more of the targets.
Ydriliqi, Rune of the River: Pick up to 2 friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of one or more of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
- While Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain is depicted on your battle scripture, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the targets' attacks.
- If Oreali, Rune of the Wind is depicted on your battle scripture, each target can immediately move up to 3". Each target can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
Oreali, Rune of the Wind: Pick up to 2 friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with one or more of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
- While Varinor, Rune of Strength is depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to each target's Move characteristic.
- While Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain is depicted on your battle scripture, add 5 to each target's control score.
Thalari, Rune of the Zenith: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units. In addition, if you have at least 4 unique runes depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units and their attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
abilities.source: BT Lumineth FR (verbatim faction_rules_fr.json « Inscription de Rune »), traduit en anglais pour l'extracteur
abilities.note: Wahapedia : tooltips des 5 runes absents de l'export CSV (texte coupé après la phrase d'introduction).

abilities.name: Master of the Runes
abilities.effect:
Remove 3 of this unit's magmic power tokens. If you do so, apply the effect below that corresponds to the UR-GOLD RUNE ability that was used:
Rune of Fury: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly FYRESLAYERS units while they have STRIKE-FIRST.
Rune of Fiery Determination: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly FYRESLAYERS units for the rest of the battle round.
Rune of Relentless Zeal: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly FYRESLAYERS units for the rest of the battle round.
Rune of Searing Heat: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly FYRESLAYERS units for the rest of the battle round.
Rune of Farsight: The range of the 'Rune of Farsight' ability is 16".
abilities.source: Faction Pack Fyreslayers FR (août 2026) p.13, « Maîtrise des Runes » : Rune d'Incandescence, Rune de Prescience
abilities.note: Wahapedia : texte coupé à « Rune of Searing Heat: Add 1 to t » (Rune of Farsight absente). Fin traduite du scan français ; les trois premières runes gardent le texte Wahapedia. Mise à jour d'octobre 2026 : rien sur cette aptitude (ses changements Fyreslayers visent le Battletome Khazalite Holds).

abilities.name: Consecrate the Land
abilities.effect:
If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be consecrated. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be consecrated.
While they are wholly within 6" of a consecrated objective and under orders:
- Friendly non-WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units have WARD (5+).
- Friendly SIGMARITE WAR MACHINES have WARD (6+).
If your opponent gains control of a consecrated objective, it is no longer consecrated.
abilities.source: BT Cités de Sigmar FR p.75 (scan, page PDF 12), charte Forgeprêtre de Mallus, « Consacrer la Terre »
abilities.note: Wahapedia : texte coupé à « have WARD ( ». Fin traduite du scan (vérifié sur l'image). Aucune mise à jour de règles (août, octobre 2026) sur cette aptitude.

abilities.name: THE SPHERE CELESTIAL
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use MOVE abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).
abilities.source: BT Cités de Sigmar FR, Artefacts de Pouvoir, « La Sphère Céleste » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json) ; annonce : Mises à jour de règles août 2026 p.37
abilities.note: Wahapedia : effet coupé à « Remove this unit from the battlefield and ». Fin traduite du français. L'annonce Wahapedia suit déjà l'errata d'août 2026 ; octobre 2026 ne change rien.

abilities.name: FURTHER THE GREAT PLAN
abilities.declare:
You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an ASTERISM that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an ASTERISM that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that ASTERISM, this ability has no effect.
- Itzl the Tamer: 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.
- Quetzl the Preserver: There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.
- Sotek the Deliverer: The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.
- Tepok the Seer: There are any friendly SLANN units on the battlefield and no friendly SLANN units are in combat or have been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Pick an ASTERISM ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied ASTERISM abilities.
abilities.source: Rules updates octobre 2026 (eng_28-10_aos_core_rules_and_key_downloads_rules_updates) p.26, « Change 'Further the Great Plan' to » (texte anglais complet)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : annonce coupée à « or have be », effet vide.

abilities.name: THE SUMMERKING'S FAVOUR
abilities.effect:
Resolve the effect of 'Renowned Might' below. If the chanting roll was 10+, resolve the effect of either 'Renowned Might' or 'Righteous Tenacity' instead.
Renowned Might: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
Righteous Tenacity: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this turn. However, after the first is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
abilities.source: BT Cours des Mangechairs FR, domaine de prières Rites du Délire, « Faveur du Roi de l'Été » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : texte coupé à « Ren ». Fin traduite du français (Puissance Réputée / Ténacité Légitime). Aucune mise à jour de règles d'octobre 2026.

abilities.name: BEGUILING GLANCE
abilities.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
Succumb: For the rest of the turn, when the target is using a CHARGE ability, it must end that charge move no further from the HERO using this ability.
Resist: For the rest of the turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target.
abilities.source: BT Hédonites de Slaanesh FR, traits de bataille, « Danse Enjôleuse » (scan, page PDF 4, vérifié sur l'image)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « no further from the ». Fin traduite du scan (« Succomber » / « Résister »).

abilities.name: ENTHRALLING VANITY
abilities.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
Mesmerised: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for attacks that target the target.
Avert Gaze: For the rest of the turn, weapon abilities (excluding Companion) of the target's melee weapons have no effect.
abilities.source: BT Hédonites de Slaanesh FR, traits de bataille, « Vanité Captivante » (scan, page PDF 4, vérifié sur l'image)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH ». Fin traduite du scan (« Fascinés » / « Détourner le Regard »).

abilities.name: SPEW FORTH SIN
abilities.effect:
Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.
If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Hypnotic Mirror, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.source: Règles de renom Hédonites de Slaanesh FR (fre_17-06_aos4_rulesofrenown_hedonites_of_slaanesh) p.2, « Bouffées de Péchés »
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « wholly within 12" of ». Fin traduite du français.

abilities.effect:
Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.
If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Hypnotic Mirror, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.
If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Hypnotic Mirror, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: TWIN TIDES
abilities.effect:
Used By: The friendly AKHELIAN unit using that ATTACK ability. Pick a visible friendly NAMARTI unit that has not used an ATTACK ability this phase to be the target.
- If this unit used a SHOOT ability, immediately after the Shoot ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase.
- If this unit used a FIGHT ability, immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit's attacks.
abilities.source: Rules updates octobre 2026 (eng_28-10_aos_core_rules_and_key_downloads_rules_updates) p.51, Battletome Idoneth Deepkin, « Add the following ability: Twin Tides » (texte anglais complet)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « immediately after the ».

abilities.name: Peal of Doom
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
- 1 - Magical Backlash: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
- 2-4 - Unholy Wall of Sound: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.
- 5-6 - Apocalyptic Doom: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.source: BT Skaven FR, charte Prophète Gris sur Cloche Hurlante, « Carillon Funeste » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : table d'effets absente (« apply the corresponding »). Traduite du français. Limitée à ce porteur : la variante Scourge of Aqshy a un autre texte.

abilities.name: Prized Creations
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
- 1-2 - Baneful Fury: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
- 3-4 - Adrenal Injection: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until your next turn.
- 5-6 - Blind Frenzy: In addition to the effect of 'Adrenal Injection', the target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.
abilities.source: BT Skaven FR, formation Ménagerie de Chair Mêlée, « Créations Prisées » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : table d'effets absente. Traduite du français.

abilities.name: Skryre Prototypes
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
- 1 - Kaboom!: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
- 2-5 - More Power!: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
- 6 - More-More Power!: In addition to the effect of 'More Power!', add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.source: BT Skaven FR, formation Convocation Rouages-Malefiques, « Prototypes Skryre » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : table d'effets absente. Traduite du français.

abilities.name: Too Horrible To Die
abilities.effect:
The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:
- 1 - Dead: This unit is destroyed.
- 2-4 - The Rats Burst Out: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.
- 5-6 - It's Alive!: This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points it would have been allocated have no effect. Then, Heal (D6) this unit.
abilities.source: BT Skaven FR, charte Abomination de Malefosse, « Trop Horrible pour Mourir » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : table d'effets absente. Traduite du français. Octobre 2026 : seulement une FAQ (Rampaging Demise), texte inchangé.

abilities.name: BRAND OF THE UNALIGNED
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.
abilities.effect:
Remove all of this unit's Pledge to Chaos keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
- PLEDGED TO KHORNE
- PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH
- PLEDGED TO NURGLE
- PLEDGED TO SLAANESH
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.source: Fléau d'Aqshy Esclaves des Ténèbres FR (fre_23-09_aos_scourge_of_aqshy_slaves_to_darkness) p.1, « Marque des Non-Alignés » ; annonce : Rules updates octobre 2026 (eng_28-10_aos_core_rules_and_key_downloads_rules_updates) p.32
abilities.note: Wahapedia : balises HTML et texte coupés. Fin traduite du français ; annonce ajoutée par la mise à jour d'octobre 2026.

abilities.name: PLEDGE TO CHAOS
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords:
- PLEDGED TO KHORNE
- PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH
- PLEDGED TO NURGLE
- PLEDGED TO SLAANESH
The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.source: BT Esclaves des Ténèbres FR, traits de bataille, « Vocation au Chaos » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)

abilities.name: SUMMON DAIS ARCANUM
abilities.effect: Set up a Dais Arcanum within ½" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up on the platform of that Dais Arcanum.
abilities.source: BT Éternels de l'Orage FR, domaine de manifestations, « Convocation de Dais Arcanum » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « visible to ». Fin traduite du français. Octobre 2026 : seul le résumé de la référence des règles change.

abilities.name: ROUSED TO FURY
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following units:
- A friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN unit that is in reserve as a dormant forest spirit.
- A friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER that has been destroyed.
Set up the unit you picked, or a replacement unit if you picked a destroyed unit, within 9" of the target, wholly within 6" of that friendly Awakened Wyldwood and not in combat. If you set up a replacement unit, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Then, remove that friendly Awakened Wyldwood from the battlefield.
abilities.source: BT Sylvaneth (scan ANGLAIS) p.92, armée de renom Lords of the Clan (page PDF 23, lue sur l'image)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « Set up the unit you picked, or a ». Texte anglais du scan.

abilities.name: Regenesis
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. If a target is a non-HERO REVENANT INFANTRY or Dryads unit, return up to D3 models to the target unit. Otherwise, Heal (3) that target.
abilities.source: Rules updates octobre 2026 (eng_28-10_aos_core_rules_and_key_downloads_rules_updates) p.75, Grove Guardian, « Change the effect of Regenesis to »
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « Othe ».

abilities.name: SONG OF PERSISTENCE
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the effect of the 'Battle Damaged' ability on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, the target has WARD (6+) until the start of your next turn.
abilities.source: BT Sylvaneth (scan ANGLAIS) p.93, armée de renom Lords of the Clan, domaine de prières (page PDF 24, lue sur l'image)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : coupé à « In additi ». Texte anglais du scan.

abilities.name: BLOOD-DRENCHED
abilities.effect:
After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a BLOOD TITHE ability this turn, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
Wild-eyed Brutality: Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
Blood Haze: If the target is BLOODBOUND, its Blood-hungry weapons have Crit (Mortal).
Weapons of Murder: If the target is a non-MONSTER DAEMON unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons, including Blood-hungry Companion weapons.
Bloodlords Supreme: If the target is a MONSTER, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons.
abilities.source: Rules updates octobre 2026 (eng_28-10_aos_core_rules_and_key_downloads_rules_updates) p.35, « Change the timing of the 'Blood-drenched' ability as shown » (texte anglais complet)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: FETTERS OF BLOOD
abilities.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
- The targets cannot use RETREAT or RUN abilities.
- The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.
abilities.source: BT Blades of Khorne, « Fers de Sang » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, rules > prayer_lores > 5)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: FINAL ACT OF VIOLENCE
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
abilities.source: BT Blades of Khorne, « Acte Final de Violence » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, rules > prayer_lores > 2)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: RUNES OF LOATHING
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
abilities.source: complétion évidente (dernier mot coupé : « MANIFESTAT »)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères ; seul le mot final manquait.

abilities.name: Words of Hate
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has an Invoker:
- Add l to chanting rolls for the Invoker.
- The Invoker cannot use MOVE abilities.
- Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Invoker, measure to this terrain feature instead.
- All attacks that would target the Invoker target this terrain feature instead.
- If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Invoker. Then, set up the Invoker on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Invoker. If the Invoker cannot be set up, it is slain.
abilities.source: BT Blades of Khorne, « Mots de Haine » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, units > Skull Altar > abilities > 0)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: DIVINE MANDATE
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
abilities.source: BT Cities of Sigmar, « Mandat Divin » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, renown_armies > Allies of the Free Cities > prayer_lores > 0)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: FORCES OF ORDER
abilities.effect:
While 3 friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the AELF keyword, 1 of those units has the DUARDIN keyword and 1 of those units has the SIGMARITE keyword:
- Those units have WARD (5+) against shooting attacks.
- Add 3 to the control scores of those units.
- Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by those units.
abilities.source: BT Cities of Sigmar, « Forces de l'Ordre » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, renown_armies > Allies of the Free Cities > battle_traits > 1)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: Field Surgery
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
- If the target is a NON-HERO INFANTRY unit, return D3 slain models to it.
- If the target is a non-HERO CAVALRY unit, return 1 slain model to it.
- If the target is a HERO or MONSTER, Heal (D3) the target.
abilities.source: BT Cities of Sigmar, « Chirurgie de Terrain » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, units > Freeguild Command Corps Auxiliaries > abilities > 1)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: Front-Line Commander
abilities.effect: If this unit is under orders, pick a friendly SIGMARITE INFANTRY or MONSTER unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit or has this unit's Relic Envoy next to it and that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
abilities.source: BT Cities of Sigmar, « Commandant de Première Ligne » (verbatim relevé dans data/json/faction_rules_fr.json, units > Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy > abilities > 1)
abilities.note: Wahapedia : description coupée à 1024 caractères (limite de l'export). Fin traduite du français.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of heat tokens equal to the number beside it.
1 Launch Countermeasures!: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly SIGMARITE units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are under orders.
2 Full Throttle!: For the rest of the turn, this unit's Move characteristic is 10".
3 Calculate Firing Solution!: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit's Godbreaker Cannon.
6 Get Us Out of Here!: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.

- Casting rolls
- Unbinding rolls
- Banishment rolls
- Run rolls
- Charge rolls in your turn
- Hit rolls
- Wound rolls
- Save rolls
